mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the status of international NGOs in international law."

fib: ______ is a central proposition in international law but it is of limited significance - primarily before judicial bodies.
Sovereign equality is a central proposition in international law but it is of limited significance - primarily before judicial bodies.
______ is concerned with statehood, of which it is a central attribute.
Sovereignty is concerned with statehood, of which it is a central attribute.
